These TSV fixtures are excerpts of the pinned MACULA Nestle 1904, SBLGNT and WLC datasets. Changes consist of selecting verses and retaining the columns exercised by bvim. Token IDs, source order and included field values come from the upstream tables.

MACULA Greek Linguistic Datasets, available at https://github.com/Clear-Bible/macula-greek/.
